description: This file contains utility functions for handling messages, content conversion, and tool integration within a Google Generative AI chat model context, including message author mapping, content transformation, and response mapping.

methods.name: getMessageAuthor
methods.description: Determines the author of a message based on its type and properties.

methods.name: convertAuthorToRole
methods.description: Maps a message author string to a Google Generative AI chat role, defaulting to 'user'.

methods.name: messageContentMedia
methods.description: Converts message content with media (image, audio, file) into a Part object.

methods.name: inferToolNameFromPreviousMessages
methods.description: Infers the tool name from previous messages based on tool calls.

methods.name: _getStandardContentBlockConverter
methods.description: Creates a content block converter configured for multimodal models supporting text, images, audio, and files.

methods.name: _convertLangChainContentToPart
methods.description: Converts complex message content into a Part object suitable for content transmission.

methods.name: convertMessageContentToParts
methods.description: Converts a message's content into an array of Parts, handling tool responses and errors.

methods.name: convertBaseMessagesToContent
methods.description: Transforms an array of base messages into structured content suitable for Google Generative AI, managing roles and content merging.

methods.name: mapGenerateContentResultToChatResult
methods.description: Maps a content generation response to a ChatResult object, including inline data handling.

methods.name: convertResponseContentToChatGenerationChunk
methods.description: Converts a generation response into a ChatGenerationChunk, including inline data and tool call chunks.

methods.name: convertToGenerativeAITools
methods.description: Converts a list of tools into a format compatible with Google Generative AI, including schema conversion.
